body: Pre-existing (surfaced in the batch-2 whole-branch review, not introduced by T-97/T-101 which only fixed the UNRESOLVED case). Once the initials preload resolves, a currency-only save resends the RESOLVED initials value — which, if the user never set a custom override, is the email-derived default (e.g. "BO" for bob@…). That writes the derived default as an explicit stored override, silently decoupling initials from a later email change (change email -> initials no longer re-derives). Fix idea: only send initials when it differs from the server-derived default, or track whether the loaded value was a real override vs a derived default and omit it otherwise (server already treats absent = leave unchanged, T-87). Files: web SettingsPage.tsx, android SettingsViewModel.kt, server resolve_initials semantics. Low priority.
title: Both clients: a resolved currency save persists the email-derived initials default as an explicit override
